messages:
sarah.cs: quick pulse — onboarding queue for EU region experienced a batch-processing delay this morning; ~120 trial tenants affected, most see slower syncs not data loss. working on customer comms draft below.

emma.enablement: thanks — can we include an explicit offer for a 1:1 enablement workshop + a one-month credit? some of these are high-touch trials w/ renewal windows.

dan.eng: root cause looks like autoscaler misfiring when a transient GPU OOM triggered fallback paths; dedicated pool routing hit a rate-limit race. mitigation: we deployed a temporary routing override to shift traffic to fallback-hosted nodes with slightly higher latency but stable throughput.

oli.sre: confirmed Dan's note. fallback is live at 10:42 UTC. KV prefix cache warm-up in progress; expected perf to normalize for most tenants within 45-60m. continuing to monitor RPC error rate.

sarah.cs: proposed outbound (short):

""Hey <customer-name>,
We’re reaching out to let you know we saw slower onboarding syncs earlier today caused by an autoscaling routing issue in our EU cluster. There was no data loss. We’ve rerouted onboarding jobs to a stable fallback while we complete a fix; most customers are back to normal.
What we’re doing: deploy a permanent routing rollback, run cache warm-up, and add enhanced throttling to prevent recurrence.
Compensation: one-month credit + invite to a 1:1 enablement session to accelerate rollout.
If you’re seeing ongoing issues, reply here or book a slot: <calendar link>.
— Redwood Inference Support""

harry.sales: +1 to the workshop/credit. can we add an exec-brief flag for any account with renewal in next 60 days? want to notify AMs.

emma.enablement: I'll draft the workshop invite template and a short troubleshooting checklist customers can try (clear local cache, re-run ingest).

dan.eng: timeline for permanent fix: patch autoscaler race + add guardrails to route selection. target deploy tom morning EU off-peak (we'll canary first). RCA will call out the race condition in route prioritization + insufficient circuit-breaker thresholds.

oli.sre: monitoring actions: create alert if fallback route >20% sustained for 5m, add dashboard tile for per-tenant onboarding latency percentiles. Also adding an incident tag so CS can filter affected tenants easily.

sarah.cs: customer segmentation for outreach:
- high-touch (renewal <60d or >$X ARR): personal note + sched exec-brief + credit
- medium (active trials >5 seats): templated note + enablement invite
- low (small trials): automated email + help doc link

sarah.cs: can folks ack if they can take the seg list and assigned outreach? I’ll own high-touch emails.

emma.enablement: taking medium; I’ll prepare the workshop cadence and FAQ.

harry.sales: will surface high-touch list to AMs and join exec-briefs for top 10.

dan.eng: will post a short postmortem doc once canary passes; expect an initial RCA summary w/in 6 hours, full doc in 48h.

oli.sre: deploy-bot: can we get a quick synthetic replay now and again after canary to validate end-to-end?
deploy-bot: scheduled job "onboard-eu-synthetic" started at 10:55 UTC, results will be posted to #eng-runtime.

sarah.cs: final check — outbound sending window: start segmented emails at 12:00 UTC, high-touch starts with personalized reachouts now (phone/zoom). capture customer feedback via this short form: <feedback link>. pls add any changes by 11:30 UTC.

emma.enablement: added troubleshooting doc link and workshop booking URL to draft.

sarah.cs: thanks team — keeping this thread for all customer-facing copy and assignment notes. will update when RCA draft is ready. :white_check_mark:
